purpose: Autopsy hypothesis mechanisms with a FILED verdict. trade_autopsy.py reads this and stops re-emitting them. HYP_DEDUPE_DAYS is a 7-day COOLDOWN, not an answer -- without this registry an already-answered question returns every week forever and the reader learns to ignore the queue.
how_to_unsettle: Delete the row (re-opens immediately), or set/advance `revisit_after` (YYYY-MM-DD) to re-open on a stated date. Never widen HYP_DEDUPE_DAYS to silence something -- that hides every mechanism, not the answered one.

settled.verdict_detail: Widening the stop is regime-conditional, not a book-wide edge. Tue 08-04 cohort -$1,111 -> +$2,097 across -15%..-50%; Wed 08-05 -$1,279 -> -$613 at best (still a loss); the 391-day gap-fade slice is MONOTONE WORSE as the stop widens. A knob that only pays on the days you cannot identify in advance is not shippable.
settled.artifact_caveat: The detector's own `stopped_then_paid` tag is partly an artifact of the hold_to_time counterfactual, which was unbounded-upside and near-stopless until it was quarantined as an ORACLE on 2026-08-06 (DIAGNOSTIC_COUNTERFACTUALS). Any re-open must re-measure with the corrected best-counterfactual column.
graveyard_refs: any stop-width change in EITHER direction
settled.revisit_condition: Re-open only with a PRE-REGISTERED regime classifier that identifies the paying regime BEFORE the entry, not after. Absent that, widening the stop is curve-fitting to the days that happened to trend.
